mapper.select: select c.comment_id, c.episode_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.content, c.like_count, c.reply_count, c.created_at, u.nick_name as nick_name, u.avatar as avatar from sys_comment c left join sys_user u on u.user_id = c.user_id where c.episode_id = #{episodeId} and c.status = 1 order by c.comment_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into sys_comment ( episode_id, user_id, parent_id, content, like_count, reply_count, status, created_at, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{episodeId}, #{userId}, #{parentId}, #{content}, 0, 0, 1, now(), #{createBy}, now() )
